## What changed

Describe the tool, play, experiment, scorecard, or outcome being added or updated.

## Why it matters

Explain the handoff removed, risk reduced, or dimension improved.

## Checklist

- [ ] I used the correct content template
- [ ] I tagged only the risks and dimensions that clearly apply
- [ ] I included limitations or guardrails where relevant
- [ ] I linked related tools, plays, experiments, or scorecards when possible
- [ ] Any impact claims are honest and proportionate
